message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data anywhere in the visible code; data is passed directly from loaders to preprocessors without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: DataDownloader fetches data (likely from the zenodo URL referenced in the CLI help) but no checksum verification, signature validation, or pinned revision is visible in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation code path.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing pipeline applies only scaling/transformation via fit_transform with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code serializes models via pickle/dill and loads configurations from CLI/config without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading pretrained weights or serialized models.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks label distributions, class balance, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defense mechanisms such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (MSE, R2, MAE) are computed and separate train/val/test loaders exist, there is no cryptographic hashing or signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement preventing test data from leaking into training, and no independent re-evaluation mechanism to guard against metric
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, schema, or type validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed through the preprocessor and into the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The fix_negatives guard in Evaluator.calculate is disabled by default (fix_negatives=False) and there are no NaN checks, range bounds, or sanity checks on predictions before they are returned or logged.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a numeric regression/federated-learning pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
